ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (white) contiguous regions occupying central lobes. Low-intensity (black) pigmentation forms a continuous margin (approx. 20-50 pixels wide) along the trailing edge. Three distinct low-intensity vertical linear streaks are mapped to the central axis at the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with a pixel-measured interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 40 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration. The left lobe displays fine-grained peaks (5-10 pixel amplitude), whereas the right lobe exhibits coarser, higher-amplitude (15-25 pixel) protrusions and deep indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, with the curve steepening toward the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple low-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters (mottling) detected across the high-intensity white field, with higher density on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of 3-4 parallel vertical black linear marks at the fluke's central junction, and two diagonal dark streaks originating from the trailing edge on the interior of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significantly jagged and irregular pixel boundaries at the far lateral tips of both lobes, suggesting historical tissue erosion or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized clusters of high-intensity (saturated) pixels along the lower fluke boundary and tips, corresponding to water spray and splash patterns.
